Key Milestone Completion - Measures seller execution and whether they have completed the right activities and conversations at each stage. Sum of all milestone scores up to and including the current stage.


Close Confidence Score - Likelihood that the deal closes, based on the latest buyer signals in calls and notes: intent, objections, competition, timeline, and stakeholder health.

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue
componentInstanceProperties.value:
Header strip: Account, Opportunity, Close (Opportunity Close Date), ACV (ACV change) and Owner (Opportunity owner). Next best step = Suggested Next Step (first 220 characters); if blank, Opportunity Next Step; if blank, the weakest open milestone in the current stage.

Milestone overview: Complete Milestone Overview. The verdict, needed before progressing, critical gaps and rep actions are parsed from this text on screen and are not stored separately.

Close confidence: reason: Close Confidence Score and Close Confidence Reason. The tile colors 70%+ green, 40 to 69% amber, under 40% red (other cards use 45%). Working for / against the deal is sorted from the reason text.

Opportunity risks: Active Risk Signal (high red, medium amber, else green) and Current Opportunity Risks, grouped on screen by keyword.

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue
componentInstanceProperties.value: Milestones by stage: one section per stage with each milestone's score and reason. Complete = score at the milestone max (3 unless noted); in progress = above 0 but under max; 0 = not started; blank = not assessed. Lane counts and statuses are calculated on screen from these scores. Current stage comes from Opportunity Stage.

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue
componentInstanceProperties.value: Milestone maxes other than 3: Partner Request Submitted (Stage 2) max 2. Partner Engaged (Stage 3) max 1, no reason field. Technical Fit Score (Stage 3) max 5. All other milestones max 3.

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue
componentInstanceProperties.value:
Forecast call: Owner call = Opportunity Forecast Category (falls back to Forecast Category on this record). Evidence category is calculated on screen from Close Confidence: 70%+ Commit, 45 to 69% Best Case, under 45% Pipeline. The verdict compares the two. Weighted = ACV change (or Opportunity Amount) x Close Confidence. Days to close is calculated from Opportunity Close Date. Push count = Opportunity Close Date Push Counter. Days in stage = Opportunity Days in Stage. To hold Commit / To move up lists the first three open milestones of the current stage.

Key Milestone Completion: Opportunity Health Score, with points earned / possible through the current stage from the PH Calc fields (set by the PH Calc Health flow). Each stage bar = that stage's points / max points. Stages after the current one are not counted yet.

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue
componentInstanceProperties.value: Deal Timing: Timing Health Score and Deal Timing Details, plus four signals (score and details each). A score of 0 or less shows Gap; above 0 shows Scored; blank shows Not assessed.

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue
componentInstanceProperties.value: Trends: built from Deal Health Snapshots (one point per day, newest snapshot wins). Close Confidence line = snapshot Close Confidence Score; Key Milestone Completion line = snapshot Health Score. Change, high, low and average are calculated on screen. See the Health Snapshots tab for the rows.
